vibe: Precise, professional, technical, trustworthy. CAD-software meets modern SaaS.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Mode B: The Control Room Grid (For Dashboards/Analytics)
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align forms and dense content. Right-align monetary/number values in tables.
spacing_and_layout.grid_structure: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Use tight gaps for data correlation.

component_rules.cards: Flat white background, 1px solid border (border-zinc-200), NO shadow. Technical and cardless feel.
component_rules.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-sm). Primary button uses solid #FF3333 with white text. Hover states must explicitly set contrast (e.g., hover:bg-[#CC0000] hover:text-white).
component_rules.inputs: Shadcn standard inputs, 1px border, focus state must have high contrast ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF3333]).
component_rules.navigation: Sticky left sidebar or fixed top header with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80) and 1px bottom border.
component_rules.tables: Dense. Use IBM Plex Mono for all numeric columns (measurements, time, price).
component_rules.data_testid: MANDATORY. All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs) must have data-testid attributes.

motion_and_interaction.hover: Subtle border color changes or -translate-y-px. No bouncy animations.
motion_and_interaction.loaders: Use minimal spinner or progressive loading bars using the primary color.

image_urls.description: Close up of machine cutting metal

instructions_to_main_agent: Use purely Shadcn UI components but strip away any soft shadows to make them feel industrial and precise.
For the cost calculator, use an F-pattern layout. The real-time quote summary should stick to the right column (col-span-1) while the inputs take up the left (col-span-2 or 3).
All currency (USD), measurements (mm/cm), and time (min/hr) outputs MUST use the mono font (IBM Plex Mono or similar).
Implement the UI in Spanish as requested (Cotizador, Materiales, Historial, etc.).
Avoid using the card component too heavily; instead, create a 'Control Room' dense UI with 1px borders.
Ensure the PDF export/print preview uses a stark white background and removes any UI navigational elements.
Ensure all components are built using .js files (JSX) and not .tsx.
Import IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono from Google Fonts in index.html or global CSS.
